Review Supademo?

Reviewers mostly praise Supademo for speed and ease: they say they can build polished interactive demos in minutes, embed them on websites, and quickly update or refine them later. Common use cases include product onboarding, sales demos, support walkthroughs, help docs, and guiding customers through specific workflows without overwhelming them. Several reviewers also highlight responsive, helpful support. Criticism is sparse, but one user says some editing controls, like combining frames and click highlights, are not very intuitive. A founder of Nimbia also says they took inspiration from it.
